method_notes: Kingston (admissions run by Achieving for Children) uses a straight-line measurement in metres from a grid reference point within the home property supplied by Ordnance Survey (the 'seed point') to the closest named school gate set out in the school's admission arrangements, calculated by the council's GIS; only GIS distances are used. Community school arrangements: main school gate, or nearest gate where more than one (nearest pedestrian gate used by the year group). Community oversubscription order: looked-after children, siblings, exceptional need, staff children, distance. No nodal points or catchment areas. Some faith/academy schools use different end points (central point of site, specific gates) or faith/parish/designated-area criteria.

gaps: 2026 figures come from the Kingston admissions guide for September 2027 entry (AfC, Aug 2026), Section 5, via the copy on St Luke's CofE Primary's website; 2023 has been dropped now that 2026 is in. Maple 2026 '8.438km' and Fern Hill '5.128km' recorded as printed. 2025 and 2024 figures are km to 3 decimals as printed in the guides (Maple 2025 '1.01 km', 2024 '1.38 km'). Eight faith schools (Christ Church Surbiton, Corpus Christi, Malden Parochial, St John's, St Joseph's, St Luke's, St Matthew's, St Paul's Chessington) are listed by the council as 'Contact the school' (in 2026 Christ Church Surbiton, St John's and St Joseph's show 'All preferences met' instead) - no cut-off published; St John's own site shows a 'last child offered under proximity' series (2025: 0.624, units unstated, likely km) but it was not recorded since units/entry point were unconfirmed. PAN field = 'places available' in the National Offer Day 2026 table; this changed six schools from the 2025 table (Christ Church Surbiton 90->60, Christ Church New Malden 30->60, Corpus Christi 60->30, Ellingham 30->60, Our Lady Immaculate 60->30, Robin Hood 30->15). The 2025 guide copies are no longer online, so whether the old values were transcription slips could not be checked. Junior-only schools (Burlington Junior, Coombe Hill Junior, Tolworth Junior, St Andrew's and St Mark's CofE Junior) excluded as they have no Reception intake. Fern Hill 2024 cut-off 14.875 km is as printed. Postcodes from the council brochure (not cross-checked against GIAS). Per-school source_url points to the 2026-data guide; 2025/2024 values come from the other listed sources.
